system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
  - path: templates/cloudsql.py
    name: cloudsql.py

resources:
  - name: saas-postgres-instance
    type: cloudsql.py
    properties:
      name: saas-postgres-instance
      databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
      tier: db-custom-2-7680
      region: us-central1
      zone: us-central1-a
      diskSize: 100
      diskType: PD_SSD
      diskAutoresize: true
      backupConfiguration:
        enabled: true
        startTime: "03:00"
        location: us
        pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        transactionLogRetentionDays: 7
        retainedBackups: 30
        retentionUnit: COUNT
      ipConfiguration:
        ipv4Enabled: false
        privateNetwork: projects/your-project-id/global/networks/default
        requireSsl: true
        authorizedNetworks: []
      databaseFlags:
        - name: cloudsql.logical_decoding
          value: "on"
        - name: max_connections
          value: "200"
        - name: work_mem
          value: "4096"
      maintenanceWindow:
        day: 7
        hour: 4
        updateTrack: stable
      insightsConfig:
        queryInsightsEnabled: true
        recordApplicationTags: true
        recordClientAddress: true
        queryStringLength: 4096
        queryPlansPerMinute: 5
      settings:
        activationPolicy: ALWAYS
        dataDiskSizeGb: 100
        dataDiskType: PD_SSD
        pricingPlan: PER_USE
        replicationType: SYNCHRONOUS
        storageAutoResize: true
        storageAutoResizeLimit: 0
        tier: db-custom-2-7680
        userLabels:
          environment: production
          application: saas-app
          managed-by: deployment-manager
      databases:
        - name: saas-db
          charset: utf8
          collation: en_US.UTF8
      users:
        - name: saas-admin
          password: "{{ env['deployment'] }}-admin-password"
          host: "%"
        - name: saas-readonly
          password: "{{ env['deployment'] }}-readonly-password"
          host: "%"
      deletionProtection: true
      denyMaintenancePeriods:
        - endDate: "2024-12-31"
          startDate: "2024-01-01"
          time: "00:00:00"
